name: OPERATION: IRON FRONT
description: Single-player open-world military sandbox on the 12 km island of Varden, against AI. Free Roam: liberate towns with your squad, take any car, tank, helicopter, jet or boat. Battle: Team Deathmatch, Domination, Conquest, King of the Hill, Capture the Flag, Sector Control, Survival. Bullet ballistics, inventory, day/night, weather. Touch controls on phones.
